title: Anne of Avonlea - An Irate Neighbor
summary: Anne of Avonlea by . Following Anne of Green Gables, the book covers the second chapter in the life of Anne Shirley. Anne of Avonlea follows Anne from the age of 16 to 18, during the two years that she teaches at Avonlea school.
